ciCommands.pnpm typecheck:all: It type-checks the web, backend, sdk, shared, chrome-extension, desktop and mobile packages and the e2e project, while the standard typecheck covers the web app only.
ciCommands.node scripts/compiler-check.mjs: It finds web files that the React Compiler skips without any build error, and fails on a skip that is not in the recorded baseline.
ciCommands.pnpm test:oxlint-plugin: It runs the tests for the repo's own oxlint rules, so a broken rule cannot pass lint by accident.
